title: Services
excerpt: Design, build and care for small business websites.
html:
Our services

We offer three connected services. You can buy them together or separately, and each one has a fixed price and a defined end point so there are no open-ended retainers by surprise.

Web design

Discovery, content structure, visual design and a clickable prototype. You leave with a design you can approve and a clear picture of what will be built. Read more about our web design process.

Web development

We build with a modern, fast stack and connect it to an editing system your team will actually enjoy using. Every build is tested for accessibility and measured against a performance budget agreed up front.

Care plans

Hosting, security updates, backups and a monthly block of time for small changes. Most clients start a care plan at launch and keep it for years.

What is included in every project

  • A written project brief that we both sign off before work begins
  • Weekly progress notes in plain language
  • Full handover documentation and a recorded training session
  • Thirty days of free fixes after launch
